APPLIED ML / ENGINEERING PROJECT

Fintech Fraud Detection

Risk predictions with an explanation attached.

A transaction-risk project combining an XGBoost ensemble, SHAP explanations, and a Flask decision dashboard.

XGBoostSHAPScikit-learnFlaskPython
View source on GitHub ↗

01 / THE PROBLEM

Why build it?

Fraud datasets are heavily imbalanced. Overall accuracy can hide poor performance on the rare transactions that matter most.

02 / THE IMPLEMENTATION

How it fits together.

The repository documents a five-fold stratified XGBoost ensemble with a preprocessing pipeline, prediction API, and SHAP-based explanations. Evaluation is a project experiment rather than proof of live financial performance.

  • Imbalanced classification and stratified evaluation
  • Transaction-level feature explanations
  • Prediction API and interactive risk dashboard
Project context

Project evaluation only. No bank deployment, prevented-loss figure, or independently validated production performance is claimed.
